description:
How This Tiny Mirror Attachment Lets a Smartphone Record Two Camera Angles with One Lens

What looks like a simple mirror is actually a clever optical accessory that enables a smartphone to record two different camera angles at the same time using just one rear camera. By reflecting light from multiple directions into a single lens, it creates a split-view recording without any electronics, batteries, or software tricks.

This innovative attachment is perfect for content creators, educators, product reviewers, livestreamers, and mobile filmmakers who want to capture both themselves and their subject simultaneously. Instead of relying on dual-camera recording modes, it uses basic optical engineering to redirect light into the camera sensor, making it compatible with almost any smartphone camera app.

Watch how this fascinating piece of optical engineering transforms a single smartphone camera into a dual-angle recording system using nothing more than mirrors and physics.

High-Efficiency Manual Grommet Installation for Industrial Tarpaulins
description: The video shows a technician operating a manual grommet press to install reinforced metal eyelets along the perimeter of a large PVC tarp. The machine utilizes a top-mounted hopper that gravity-feeds the metal components into the setting dies, streamlining a process that would otherwise require separate punching and crimping steps. By pulling the extended lever, the operator applies significant mechanical pressure to pierce the heavy-duty fabric and permanently deform the metal ring around the opening. This cold-pressing technique ensures a durable bond that distributes stress evenly across the material, preventing fraying or tearing during use.
